facial.standard: ARKit-compatible naming subset plus blink, jaw and emotion shapes

runtimeGenerationPolicy.allowed: Preset and material composition using validated assets.
runtimeGenerationPolicy.notAllowed: Untested arbitrary topology inserted directly into a live round.
runtimeGenerationPolicy.customHeadPipeline: Generate concept, fit to standard head topology, transfer blendshapes, validate rig and LODs, then publish as an approved preset.

acceptance: Both bodies play the same animation events without retiming.
Eyes and mouth remain readable at the portrait production camera.
All fingers close around the card without visible penetration.
Uniform and hair do not enter the dealing envelope.
Viseme playback follows deterministic audio timing.
